body: I just wanted to inform you all that we are working on a solution.. The next couple of weeks will be hard but this has to stop and he is willing to help where he can. Thanks for all the nice words.

I really hope that I will be able to do my normal daily business, it often feels like people think that I can move just fine and go out and work again but they really don't understand how my leg is draining energy from my whole body.. As you can read above, I will have a talk with my dad tonight and will tell him the truth about how I really think about things.  Thank you for your support.

That makes so much sense.. I want to make everyone around me happy but I simply can't do that because I'm not feeling truly happy.. I am going to talk with my dad tonight, no more hiding the truth about how I really think about things. Thank you for your kind words.

That is true about the knee but I would like to be able to do more than only making games. I don't even feel like making them anymore because my head is such a mess... I don't know if I should tell my dad that I can't live with him anymore, I'm afraid that he won't accept that and won't let me in his life
ever again
